title: Cable Technician
description:
RIGHTECH is a leading nationwide provider of technical staffing services, and we are currently seeking qualified candidates for a Cable Technician role in Denver, CO. This role is a contract to hire position with travel.

Job Title: Structured Cable Technician
Location: Denver, CO
Job Description:
Key Responsibilities:
  • Cabling: Run, terminate, and test CAT 5 and CAT 6 cables according to industry standards.
  • Sound masking installation
  • Drilling and Mounting: Drill and securely mount speakers and other equipment as required.
  • Ladder Work: Safely work on ladders to install and maintain equipment at heights.
  • Documentation: Maintain accurate records of work performed, including cable runs, installations, and troubleshooting steps.
  • Dress and route cable into IT closets, modular furniture, and other work area outlets.
  • Cable pathway installation (J-hooks, D-rings, cable trays, and ladder racks).
  • Cable management (dressing, labeling).
  • Cable Termination (Patch Panel, Jacks, Keystones, RJ-45/Modular Plug).
  • IT Closet Builds (MDF, IDF, Data rack, ladder rack, cable tray, sleeve installation)
  • Read and follow blueprints set for installation.
  • Safety Compliance: Follow all safety protocols and procedures to ensure a safe working environment.
Qualifications:
  • Experience: Proven experience in running CAT 5 and CAT 6 cables, and installing network hardware.
  • Tools: Must provide own tools.
  • Physical Requirements: Ability to work on ladders and over head
  • Technical Skills: Basic understanding of cabling infrastructure.
    • AV & Security installation experience is helpful.
  • Problem-Solving: Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to work independently and efficiently.
  • Communication: Good communication skills to interact with team members and clients.
  • Safety Awareness: Knowledge of safety practices related to working with electrical equipment, ladders, and power tools.
Required Tools:
  • Basic hand tools
  • Screwdriver (multi-Bit)
  • Torpedo level
  • Tape measure
  • Snips
  • Pliers (needle nose and channel locks)
  • Cable stripper
  • punch down tool
  • modular plug crimper
  • Flash light – not the one on the phone
  • Fish tape
  • Electrical tape
  • Cordless drill
  • Impact driver
  • Various sizes of wood, metal and masonry drill bits
  • Various sizes and types of driver bits
PPE:
Safety Vest, Safety Glasses, Work Gloves, Hard Hat, Work Boots (Steel toe or composite)
